issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice: The problem statement explicitly requires calculateTotalPrice to be a static method (shared, using the shared stock). The solution implementation declares calculateTotalPrice as an instance method (public int calculateTotalPrice(Meal)). This mismatch leaves students unsure whether the method should be static and may cause confusion or test failures when code or tests expect a static method that uses the shared stock field.
issues.suggestedFix: Make SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice static to match the problem specification: change the signature to public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal). In the method body, reference the static stock field (already declared static in the solution) and ensure any call sites are updated if necessary (e.g., use SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal) or allow instance calls if desired). This aligns the solution with the written requirements and removes ambiguity for students and tests.
